messages:
nina: quick heads up 44 customer hit 413 with an embeddings payload ~2.2MB (mixed dims). preflight estimated 1,200 units, runtime ended up charging ~2,400. filing a support case now but want engineering consensus on headers/UX.

sam: that's rough. do we know why estimate was so off?

nina: preflight uses a bytes->units heuristic and assumes quantization factor X. splitter at runtime selected the 8-bit path which bumped unit accounting for some sequence padding; combination doubled cost. mismatch between preflight and runtime heuristics.

marco: from console side we need deterministic numbers to show customers. my proposal: expose both optimistic and conservative estimates via headers so UI can show a range. e.g. `X-Redwood-Embed-Estimate: optimistic=1200;conservative=2400` and a `X-Redwood-Embed-Plan: split=2;parts=...` for suggested splitter boundaries.

li: minor nit: headers should be compact. maybe `X-RW-Embed-Est: low=1200;high=2400` and `X-RW-Embed-Plan: s=2;r=0-1023,1024-2047`.

trina: product tilt: make preflight conservative by default to reduce bill shock. show optimistic in details. auto-split is controversial for mobile SDKs.

sam: SDK approach: default `auto_split=false`, but provide an opt-in `split_on_413=true`. also library can read `X-RW-Embed-Est` and optionally surface a pre-send warning in debug builds.

nina: implementation hint: computing conservative estimate is cheap; aligning preflight to runtime heuristics is doable by moving quantization decision into preflight code path. drawback: preflight latency up a few ms.

marco: console UX: show "Estimated units: 1200 (best) / 2400 (worst)" with a link "Apply suggested split" that will give a one-click resubmit for the failing payload. also add a telemetry link that opens the trace where estimate diverged.

sam: telemetry: emit `embed.estimate_mismatch` with fields `tenant_id`, `model`, `dims`, `preflight_low`, `runtime_units`, `split_applied`. alert if mismatch_rate > 0.5% for top 100 tenants.

nina: add a debug sample event with the raw preflight decisions for later audits. keep this sample-rate low (0.1%).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling deploy started for `embed-preflight-v2` canary 5% at 2026-03-21T15:12Z.

marco: I'll write UI copy and add a console flag to show only conservative estimate for billing pages.

li: will update header names in spec. sam/nina, can you finalize telemetry + SDK opt-in by EOD?

sam: yes. nina: will run the preflight-vs-runtime trace over last 7 days and post stats.

nina: done. baseline shows ~0.7% mismatches, mostly on mixed-dim inputs >1MB. will post numbers in the ticket.

trina: thank you team. reduce support tickets = win. :thumbsup:
